claims.claim: On 2026-11-16 Aave (V3+V4) TVL was $15.11B and Morpho TVL was $10.22B per DefiLlama; Morpho was about 12% below its 2026-11-05 record.
On 2026-11-16 Aave borrowed was $11.10B and Morpho borrowed was $5.34B per DefiLlama.
Since 2025-09-01 Aave V3 borrowed fell from $28.13B to $10.59B while Morpho borrowed rose from $3.49B to $5.34B; Aave TVL -61.4%, Morpho TVL +37.8%.
Coinbase's variable-rate bitcoin-backed loans exceeded $1.4B outstanding while Morpho Blue had about $5.2B of loans and $16B of deposits across all integrations (2026-09-22).
Protofire's 2026-10-18 snapshot counted 59 Morpho RWA-type markets with about $657.2M borrowed and Aave Horizon with $121.4M borrowed.
Aave Horizon TVL excluding loans was $254.3M on 2026-10-18, down from $420.9M on 2026-01-12.
Aave protocol revenue was $27,288,040 in Q2 2026 and $17,292,461 in Q3 2026, $44,580,501 over 180 days, per Aave Labs' unaudited report.
Aave Labs net product revenue was $1,174,178.39 in Q2 and $1,307,808 in Q3 2026, mostly Aave Pro/aave.com CoW fees; Horizon contributed about $100K per quarter.
Aave Labs spent $19,477,553 excluding token compensation in Q2+Q3 2026, of which BD & Growth was $3,565,083; headcount was 97.

Per the 1kx 2026 blockchain revenue report, Morpho took $62M in user-paid fees in Q3 2026, ranked second among lending markets, much going to curators; onchain lending user-paid fees fell about 50% year over year.
DefiLlama showed 30-day fees of $42,019,860 for Aave and $34,068,051 for Morpho, and trailing-year fees of $601,839,047 and $214,918,206; DefiLlama states no revenue accrues to the Morpho protocol.
On 2026-04-18 116,500 rsETH (about $292M) was taken from Kelp's bridge; Aave-specific bad-debt exposure was roughly $196M, Aave TVL fell from $26.4B to nearly $20B and AAVE fell 16%.
Morpho's CEO reported only about $1M of rsETH exposure across two isolated markets, which Galaxy attributes to per-market isolation.
Aave V4 launched on Ethereum on 2026-03-30 with Prime, Core and Plus hubs and launch spokes including Lido, EtherFi, Kelp, Ethena and Lombard; each hub gives a credit line to each spoke.
Aave V4 supplied grew from $212.6M on 2026-07-01 to $1.34B on 2026-10-01 (borrowed $402.9M, TVL $932.8M on Oct 1; high of $1.41B on Oct 12).
The Aave Will Win temp check proposed routing 100% of Aave-branded product revenue to the DAO treasury, with Aave Labs funded $25M in stablecoins and 75,000 AAVE vesting over two years.
Morpho Association raised $175M co-led by Paradigm, a16z crypto and Ribbit, with Apollo Funds, Circle Ventures, VanEck and Ledger Cathay as strategic participants, and states $11B+ in deposits.
The June 2026 Morpho raise was a purchase of MORPHO tokens at the monthly average price, reported at a valuation of up to $2B.
Apollo affiliates may acquire up to 90M MORPHO over 48 months under a cooperation agreement announced 2026-02-13, with transfer and trading restrictions.
Morpho Midnight, a noncustodial fixed-rate fixed-term credit protocol, launched on Base on 2026-07-21 with a cbBTC/USDC pair and limited maturities.
Morpho's October 2026 recap puts Midnight deposits at about $200M and its September recap puts total Morpho deposits above $17B (two different months).

On 2026-07-14 Steakhouse reported Morpho USDC supply above $2.8B, over half in Steakhouse vaults (about $1.4B), about 65% of Base USDC via Steakhouse including about $368M from the Coinbase App lending product.
Base announced Earn & Borrow on 2026-10-13 letting apps embed lending through Morpho and Aave; a secondary summary puts Morpho on Base at about $4.38B TVL and Aave V3 on Base at about $533M.
Anyone can create a Morpho Blue market via createMarket with five parameters (loan token, collateral token, oracle, LLTV, IRM), but the LLTV must be one governance has enabled.
Since 2026-08-14 Aave Horizon listings require an ARFC with a business case, a LlamaRisk assessment, an Aave Labs technical assessment and a binding Snapshot vote.
In Protofire's 2026-10-18 snapshot, six Morpho Treasury-token markets (BUIDL, USTB, USDY, JTRSY, VBILL, USYC) held $0, while one PRIME/PYUSD market had $186.1M borrowed against $259.4M.
Token Terminal's September 2026 figures: Aave active loans $12.6B (47% of tracked loans, down 17.4 points year on year), fees $36.5M (-65.7% YoY), DAO revenue $5.2M.
Aave buybacks were halted effective 2026-04-19 by an ARFC after the rsETH incident, and a thread to restart them auto-closed on 2026-07-26 without a vote.
Galaxy's GOFR product blends rates from Aave, Morpho, Spark, Kamino and others into a single continuously rebalanced rate, with Galaxy committing up to $100M of first-loss capital.
After Stream Finance's $93M loss in November 2025, Yields and More mapped about $285M of potential exposure across DeFi and put MEV Capital's at about $25.4M.

Aave Labs reports partners building on V4 and Horizon: EtherFi Cash with over 100,000 cardholders, Coinbase tokenized stocks on Base citing Aave as the sole credit infrastructure, and Circle Mint USDC borrowing against cirBTC on Arc.
Morpho's recaps report Arc launching with $220M+ of day-one deposits, Robinhood Chain deposits reaching $1B within three months, and total deposits above $17B.

Tiger Research (June 2026) says Morpho Blue is immutable with five fixed parameters per market and independent curators, Aave V4 uses a hub assigning credit lines to spokes, and capital concentrates with Steakhouse, Gauntlet and Sentora; all three protocols converge on modular design.
DefiLlama's tvl endpoints returned $13.666B for Aave V3 and $9.908B for Morpho (morpho-v1) when fetched on 2026-11-19.
DefiLlama lending ranking on 2026-09-15: Aave V3 $16.8B, Morpho Blue $9.8B, SparkLend $4.9B, JustLend $3.6B, Compound V3 $1.4B, Kamino $1.3B, Fluid $748M, Euler V2 $328M.
On 2026-11-16 Aave V3 lent out 43% of deposits versus 35% for Morpho Blue.
On 2026-11-18 @anzep13 wrote that Morpho and Aave are in a full BD war, taking different strategies, with liquidity and asset support the obvious factors.
Aave's 2025 recap says Horizon ended 2025 with over $570 million in deposits and lists partners including VanEck, Circle, Securitize, Ripple, WisdomTree and Superstate.
Morpho Vaults V2 splits roles into owner, curator, allocator and sentinel, with timelocks and an adapter architecture.
Morpho's Association says the DAO is considering protocol fees and that MORPHO is the only asset; 4Pillars noted in March 2026 that no fee-switch proposal had appeared in 128 Snapshot votes.
Coinbase's >$1.4B of loans is about 27% of Morpho Blue's roughly $5.2B outstanding loans.
assumptions: Coinbase and Blue figures are as reported 2026-09-22; Coinbase's >$1.4B is a floor
